CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.noise(noise_value anyelement, ratio double precision)
 RETURNS anyelement
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  res ALIAS FOR $0;
  ran float;
BEGIN
  ran = (2.0 * random() - 1.0) * ratio;
  SELECT (noise_value * (1.0 - ran))::ANYELEMENT
    INTO res;
  RETURN res;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN numeric_value_out_of_range THEN
    SELECT (noise_value * (1.0 + ran))::ANYELEMENT
      INTO res;
    RETURN res;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.dnoise(noise_value anyelement, noise_range interval)
 RETURNS anyelement
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  res ALIAS FOR $0;
  ran INTERVAL;
BEGIN
  ran = (2.0 * random() - 1.0) * noise_range;
  SELECT (noise_value + ran)::ANYELEMENT
    INTO res;
  RETURN res;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN datetime_field_overflow THEN
    SELECT (noise_value - ran)::ANYELEMENT
      INTO res;
    RETURN res;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.digest(seed text, salt text, algorithm text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(digest(concat(seed,salt),algorithm),'hex');
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.partial(ov text, prefix integer, padding text, suffix integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
  SELECT substring(ov FROM 1 FOR prefix)
      || padding
      || substring(ov FROM (length(ov)-suffix+1) FOR suffix);
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.partial_email(ov text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN substring(ov, 1, 2) || '******' ||
         '@' ||
         substring(ov from position('@' in ov) + 1 for position('.' in reverse(ov)) - 2) ||
         '******' ||
         '.' ||
         right(ov, position('.' in reverse(ov)) - 1);
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_string(l integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT array_to_string(
    array(
        select substr('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789',
                      ((random()*(36-1)+1)::integer)
                      ,1)
        from generate_series(1,l)
    ),''
  );
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_zip()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT array_to_string(
         array(
                select substr('0123456789',((random()*(10-1)+1)::integer),1)
                from generate_series(1,6)
            ),''
          );
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_inn()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT array_to_string(
         array(
                select substr('0123456789',((random()*(10-1)+1)::integer),1)
                from generate_series(1,8)
            ),''
          );
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_date_between(date_start timestamp with time zone, date_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT
AS $function$
    SELECT (random()*(date_end-date_start))::interval+date_start;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_date()
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT anon_funcs.random_date_between('1900-01-01'::timestamp with time zone,now());
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_int_between(int_start integer, int_stop integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT
AS $function$
    SELECT FLOOR(random()*(int_stop-int_start)+int_start)::INTEGER;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_bigint_between(int_start bigint, int_stop bigint)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT
AS $function$
    SELECT FLOOR(random()*(int_stop-int_start)+int_start)::BIGINT;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_phone(phone_prefix text DEFAULT '0'::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT  phone_prefix
          || CAST(anon_funcs.random_int_between(100000000,999999999) AS TEXT)
          AS "phone";
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_hash(seed text, algorithm text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL RESTRICTED STRICT SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  SELECT anon_funcs.digest(
    seed,
    anon_funcs.random_string(6),
    algorithm
  );
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.random_in(a anyarray)
 RETURNS anyelement
 LANGUAGE sql
 STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT a[pg_catalog.floor(pg_catalog.random()*array_length(a,1)+1)]
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION anon_funcs.hex_to_int(hexval text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    result  INT;
BEGIN
    EXECUTE 'SELECT x' || quote_literal(hexval) || '::INT' INTO result;
    RETURN result;
END;
$function$
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tg_core.tg_trg_fn()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $function$
